field_notes.provider_question_id: Null for every row: no reliable provider question IDs recovered; local composite IDs are section-scoped.
field_notes.set_id: DILR block IDs are local analyst groupings, not provider IDs. Null elsewhere because no reliable grouping references were imported.
field_notes.question_text: Null for all rows: full exact stems/passages were not recovered.
field_notes.options: Null for all rows: complete answer-option text was not recovered.
field_notes.recovered_stem_excerpt: Literal short UI snippet; not a full question and not a reconstructed stem.
field_notes.original_response: Null unless independently retained in an opened source. A correct outcome is not used to infer an answer.
field_notes.correct_answer: Null unless retained in an opened source. Only SimCAT 2 QA Q3 has option-label evidence from a prior analyst narrative, without the screenshot.
field_notes.time_seconds: Non-negative integer converted from question MM:SS. Zero means zero recorded time, not proof that a question was never seen.
field_notes.marks: Preserved per-question score; wrong TITA-like zero-mark responses are not assigned -1.
field_notes.outcome: correct, wrong or skipped from the provider topic evidence, cross-checked with status icons.
field_notes.provider_difficulty_type: Original retrospective IMS A/B/C label, not a personal-difficulty claim.
